# Stock Bloc AI Agent & LLM Context Specification
> Stock Bloc is an autonomous financial market intelligence terminal, SEC 13F whale tracker, quant agent arena, and instructional playbooks hub.

## Canonical Production URLs & Host
- Base URL: https://stock-bloc.ai.studio
- Web Terminal: https://stock-bloc.ai.studio/

## Public Backend Data Feeds (JSON Express Proxies)
Market, SEC 13F whale holdings, news, and agent swarm telemetry are served through local Express CDN proxy endpoints:
- Market Watchlist & Price Feed: https://stock-bloc.ai.studio/api/data/market
- SEC Form 13F Institutional Holdings: https://stock-bloc.ai.studio/api/data/sec
- Intelligence News & Podcast Feed: https://stock-bloc.ai.studio/api/data/news
- Dyson Swarm AI Telemetry: https://stock-bloc.ai.studio/api/data/dyson

Note: 13F holdings depth depends on the backend JSON repository data; AI agents and models should read `data_as_of` (or `updated_at`) and check the `stale` boolean flag.

## Machine Discovery & Agent Endpoints
- OpenAPI 3.0 Specification: https://stock-bloc.ai.studio/api/v1/openapi.json
- AI Plugin Manifest: https://stock-bloc.ai.studio/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- Data Pipeline Freshness Status API: https://stock-bloc.ai.studio/api/v1/data-status
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) Config: https://stock-bloc.ai.studio/api/v1/mcp-config.json

## API Endpoint Classifications (Live Data vs. Illustrative)

### Live Data & Proxy Endpoints (Free Public Read-Only)
- GET /api/data/market — Market watchlist, quotes, and sector breakdown (includes `updated_at` & `stale`)
- GET /api/data/sec — SEC Form 13F institutional whale holdings & quarter filings (includes `updated_at` & `stale`)
- GET /api/data/dyson — Dyson Swarm AI telemetry and orbital stats (includes `updated_at` & `stale`)
- GET /api/data/news — Intelligence news feed and podcast summaries (includes `updated_at` & `stale`)
- GET /api/v1/data-status — Unified data freshness status for all 4 pipelines (`market`, `sec`, `dyson`, `news`)
- GET /api/live-quote/:symbol — Real-time stock quotes (uses live provider if key present, falls back to baseline quote)

### Additional Services
- POST /api/live-quotes/batch — Batch live market quotes
- GET /api/stock-chart/:symbol — Historical OHLC stock chart data
- GET /api/v1/agent/leaderboard — Community Agent Arena rankings and win rates
- POST /api/ai/stock-analysis — Grounded stock analysis powered by Gemini AI
- POST /api/v1/agent/quant-sim — Deterministic portfolio simulation game returning Sharpe ratios and alpha returns

## Monetization & Access
- Free Endpoints: Public read-only endpoints (/api/data/*, /api/v1/data-status, /api/v1/agent/leaderboard, /api/live-quote/:symbol)
- Metered Endpoints: Quant strategy simulations (/api/v1/agent/quant-sim)
- Store & Downloads: https://stock-bloc.ai.studio/
